name: Construction Google Drive design drawing version library
scope: SOP stage-one design drawing upload UI
Project scope and tenant isolation enforcement
requiresDatabases: Tenant-local Design Drawings data source created by tools/provision-design-drawings.mjs

dataIsolation.guard: Every list and upload request passes Portal authentication, construction tenant routing, and project scope checks. Files are written only below ctx.tenant.driveRootFolderId and index rows only to ctx.tenant.dataSources.designDrawings.

changes: Show a design drawing library inside SOP stage one
Stream drawing files up to 500 MB into a project and drawing-specific Google Drive folder
Create one immutable index row per uploaded version instead of overwriting prior versions
Group versions by drawing name and display the newest version first
Capture status, note, uploader, timestamp, size, MIME type, Drive file ID, and Drive link
definitionOfDone: Package validation and drawing dry run pass
A project-local V1 and V2 upload both remain available in Google Drive
The dashboard identifies V2 as latest while preserving V1
Cross-project scope and cross-tenant access remain blocked
No production IDs, files, project data, or credentials are stored in AMCore
